module_summary: RGMII-to-GMII PHY interface: DDR input capture converts RGMII receive nibbles to GMII bytes, while a speed-dependent clock divider and ODDR outputs serialize GMII transmit data onto RGMII, with reset synchronizers per domain.

anchors.name: speed
anchors.why: Selects 10/100/1000 mode for tx clock divider and nibble mapping.

anchors.name: phy_rgmii_rxd
anchors.why: RGMII DDR receive nibbles captured by ssio_ddr_in.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_rxd
anchors.why: GMII receive byte assembled from both DDR edges.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_txd
anchors.why: GMII transmit byte split into RGMII nibbles per speed.

anchors.name: phy_rgmii_txd
anchors.why: RGMII DDR transmit nibbles driven by data ODDR.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_rx_dv
anchors.why: GMII receive data valid from rising-edge rx_ctl.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_rx_er
anchors.why: GMII receive error decoded as XOR of both rx_ctl edges.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_tx_en
anchors.why: GMII transmit enable encoded into RGMII tx_ctl.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_tx_er
anchors.why: GMII transmit error XORed into second tx_ctl edge.

anchors.name: phy_rgmii_tx_ctl
anchors.why: RGMII DDR transmit control from data ODDR.

anchors.name: count_reg
anchors.why: Divider counter generating 10M/100M transmit clock phases.

anchors.name: rgmii_tx_clk_1
anchors.why: Divided transmit clock level for rising edge, also steers tx_ctl.

anchors.name: rgmii_tx_clk_2
anchors.why: Divided transmit clock level for falling edge of clock ODDR.

anchors.name: mac_gmii_tx_clk_en
anchors.why: Clock enable telling MAC when to present next GMII beat.

anchors.name: phy_rgmii_tx_clk
anchors.why: Forwarded RGMII transmit clock from clock ODDR.

anchors.name: rgmii_txd_1
anchors.why: Rising-edge transmit nibble selected by speed.

anchors.name: rgmii_tx_ctl_1
anchors.why: Rising-edge tx_ctl encoding of tx_en/tx_er.

anchors.name: rgmii_rx_ctl_1
anchors.why: Captured rising-edge rx_ctl driving rx_dv and rx_er.

anchors.name: tx_rst_reg
anchors.why: Transmit-domain reset synchronizer shift register.

anchors.name: rx_rst_reg
anchors.why: Receive-domain reset synchronizer shift register.

groups.name: RGMII receive DDR capture
groups.description: ssio_ddr_in captures RGMII nibbles on both edges into GMII byte and dv/er.

groups.name: Transmit clock divider
groups.description: Speed-dependent counter generates tx clock phases and MAC clock enable.

groups.name: RGMII transmit DDR output
groups.description: Maps GMII byte to rising/falling nibbles and drives them through ODDRs.

groups.name: Reset synchronizers
groups.description: Per-domain shift registers generating synchronized MAC rx/tx resets.
